subject: Request: Short-term H100 Reservation + Burst Cap & Overage Cap (Astralytics)
messages:
From: Elena Martinez <elena@astralytics.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tim O'Neil <tim.oneil@astralytics.com>, procure@astralytics.com
Date: 2028-03-20T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Request: Short-term H100 Reservation + Burst Cap & Overage Cap

Sean —

Following up from last week's call. Our training cadence next quarter spikes for a six-week window (starting 2028-04-03) and our current A100 reservation is insufficient. We've validated our models will benefit from H100 for this burst period. Can Redwood provision a short-term reservation for 8 H100s (6 weeks) and enable burst capacity up to 200% for 10 days at the start of the window?

To be commercial-friendly, we need an overage cap (not to exceed $XX/hr per H100 equivalent) and a reservation hold (no preemption) for the first 48 hours of each burst day. We know this is non-standard so we're happy to sign a short addendum or amend the SOW.

Attached: Astralytics_SOW_v3.pdf and a Q1 usage extract.

Thanks —
Elena Martinez
Head of Infrastructure
Astralytics

[attachment: Astralytics_SOW_v3.pdf] [attachment: usage_report_Q1.csv]

From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Martinez <elena@astralytics.com>
Cc: lauren_bishop@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Date: 2028-03-21T08:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: Short-term H100 Reservation + Burst Cap & Overage Cap

Elena — thanks for the clear ask and the SOW. I'm looping in Lauren (deal desk) and Karthik (legal) to scope feasible commercial terms.

Quick read: 8 H100s, 6 weeks, 200% burst for 10 days, 48h hold window for first 48h of burst days, capped overage. We'll need an exec exception for H100 short-term reservations and a limited non-preemptible SLA window.

Lauren/Karthik — can you propose an internal concession (pricing and amendment language)? If we can get Marissa to sign off on an exception, I will route the DocuSign addendum to Astralytics. Tim, if you have target numbers for overage ceiling, drop them here.

Sean
Director, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference

From: lauren_bishop@redwood.ai <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>, Elena Martinez <elena@astralytics.com>
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Date: 2028-03-21T10:33:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: Short-term H100 Reservation + Burst Cap & Overage Cap

Thanks Sean / Elena — internal note first (below) so we have a concrete proposal to take to execs: 

Proposal summary (deal desk recommend):
- Reservation: 8 x H100 equivalent, term = 6 weeks (2028-04-03 to 2028-05-14)
- Burst: permitted up to 200% capacity for first 10 days of the term window
- Hold clause: Redwood will provide a 48-hour non-preemptible window during the first 48 hours of each burst day (not every day) for critical checkpoints
- Pricing: flat reservation fee equivalent to current H100 list discounted by 20% during the reservation term (volume concession), with overage capped at $45/hr per H100-equivalent during the burst period (this is a provisional cap)
- Billing: reservation invoiced upfront for 50% on signing, remaining 50% invoiced mid-term; overages billed monthly with a hard cap per-day aligned to the $45/hr ceiling
- Termination: single short addendum to existing SOW (attached link) with defined start/end; early termination triggers pro-rated refund calculation.

Risks / notes from deal desk:
- H100 short-term swaps create allocation strain; we need written commitment to invoice terms to justify priority.
- Legal will want a tight definition of "burst day" and the mechanism for the 48-hour hold (scheduling windows, job tags, or prefix-based reservations).

If acceptable to Astralytics, I'll escalate for exec sign-off (Marissa) and coordinate DocuSign.

-lauren
Senior Deal Manager, Redwood Inference

[internal: proposal deck draft uploaded to drive — link will be attached after exec review]

From: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: lauren_bishop@redwood.ai, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>
Cc: Elena Martinez <elena@astralytics.com>
Date: 2028-03-21T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: Short-term H100 Reservation + Burst Cap & Overage Cap

Quick legal flags / redlines: 
1) Define "H100-equivalent" precisely (SKU mapping). Avoid ambiguous equivalence language.
2) The 48-hour non-preemptible hold needs a clear enforcement mechanism — suggest adding a "priority tag" and specifying that Redwood will not preempt jobs marked with that tag during the hold window.
3) Limit the number of burst days where the hold can apply (Lauren suggested "first 48 hours of each burst day" — let's instead say "one 48-hour non-preemptible hold per contiguous 72-hour period" to reduce complexity).
4) Add force-majeure carveouts and explicit capacity-exhaustion fallback (e.g., automatic fallback to A100 variants with a different overage rate if H100 capacity cannot be provisioned 24 hours before window).

I'll draft redlined addendum language and share. Once Marissa signs off on the commercial concession, legal will finalize quickly.

-karthik

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: lauren_bishop@redwood.ai, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Date: 2028-03-22T09:52:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: Short-term H100 Reservation + Burst Cap & Overage Cap

Team — reviewed Lauren's proposal and Karthik's redlines. Approved with conditions: 
1) Approve the 20% reservation discount for the 6-week term.
2) Approve the overage cap at $45/hr per H100-equivalent, but limit cumulative overage liability to 150% of the reservation fee across the term.
3) Approve a single 48-hour non-preemptible hold to be scheduled for one contiguous 72-hour block during the 10-day burst window (Astralytics to provide desired hold dates at least 7 days in advance).
4) If we cannot guarantee H100 capacity 24 hours before the scheduled hold, automatic fallback to the nearest A100-equivalent will occur and overage rate will default to standard A100 overage pricing.

Conditions are administrative — legal to insert fallback language and enforcement mechanics. Lauren, Karthik: route the addendum to DocuSign and copy me on the outbound. Sean, once signed, confirm start invoice schedule and we'll mark the allocation in the resource planner.

-marissa

From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Martinez <elena@astralytics.com>, Tim O'Neil <tim.oneil@astralytics.com>
Cc: lauren_bishop@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: 2028-03-22T15:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: Short-term H100 Reservation + Burst Cap & Overage Cap

Elena / Tim — good news: internal signoff received. Key points below and next steps: 

What was approved:
- 8 x H100 reservation for 6 weeks (2028-04-03 to 2028-05-14) with a 20% reservation discount
- Burst allowed up to 200% for the first 10 days; one 48-hour non-preemptible hold (scheduled as one contiguous 72-hour block inside the 10-day burst window)
- Overage cap at $45/hr per H100-equivalent with cumulative overage liability capped at 150% of the reservation fee
- Fallback to A100-equivalent if H100 cannot be guaranteed 24 hours before the hold window (standard A100 overage pricing applies in that case)

Attachments: we've redlined the addendum and uploaded it to the Drive. DocuSign link: https://redwood.app/ds/DocuSign/Astralytics-ShortTerm-SOW

Action items for Astralytics:
- Confirm desired 72-hour non-preemptible block by 2028-03-25 EOD so we can lock H100 capacity
- Sign the DocuSign addendum (link above) to trigger 50% upfront invoice and allocation hold

Lauren/legal will send the DocuSign envelope shortly. Thanks all — appreciate the quick coordination.

Sean Gallagher
Director, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
